description: Cross-backend packet-AEAD golden vector (RFC 8439 ChaCha20-Poly1305, 12-byte nonce, 16-byte tag). The native build seals with ring::aead::LessSafeKey, the wasm32 build with the RustCrypto chacha20poly1305 crate; both must produce this exact ciphertext||tag for the same (key, nonce, aad, plaintext), or the AEAD seam has changed the wire format.
